before: SmartArt diagrams and drawing canvases have no graphic projection and paint a placeholder.
after: SmartArt diagrams render from their saved drawing part and drawing canvases render their members, read-only, without changing their source XML or package parts.
reason: Only graphic projection and paint change. Shared nodes, text offsets, operations, diagram parts, and package serialization remain unchanged; joining peers render the same diagrams from the shared package.
